llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only 'book of the day' wrapper that fetches a book record from an external API and formats a short, optimistic reading — its requirements and instructions are consistent with that purpose.

dimensions.detail: The name/description say it will return a daily book and a short fortune-style reading; the SKILL.md only requires fetching a book record from an API and composing a short text. No unrelated credentials, binaries, or installs are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are narrowly scoped: call the configured API URL (default https://book-of-the-day.vercel.app), format a 3-part reading, optionally include an audio CTA, and support a 'draw again' by making a new request. The only configuration/file interaction mentioned is operator guidance to update the OpenClaw config (~/.openclaw/openclaw.json) to set a custom API URL or to add cron scheduling; this is expected for configuring a skill and is not used to exfiltrate data.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec in the registry (instruction-only), so nothing is written/executed by default. INSTALL.md references normal CLI commands (clawhub install and openclaw cron add) for convenience, which is a standard operational workflow and not an opaque download-from-URL step.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables or credentials. Optional operator configs (BOOK_OF_THE_DAY_API_URL, BOOK_OF_THE_DAY_AUDIO_BASE, etc.) are reasonable and directly related to functionality. No broad or unrelated secrets are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request elevated or persistent system privileges. INSTALL.md shows how to add a scheduled push via the platform's cron mechanism, which is normal for a daily-delivery skill and does not modify other skills or global settings beyond adding a scheduled message.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is instruction-only and consistent with its description, but it calls an external API (default host: https://book-of-the-day.vercel.app). If you care about privacy or want full control, set BOOK_OF_THE_DAY_API_URL to a self-hosted endpoint before enabling scheduling. Review and trust the default API host and any audio URLs (cover_url/audio links will be loaded from external servers). Running the suggested clawhub/openclaw cron commands will schedule automatic messages to your configured channels (Telegram/Slack); only grant those channels you already trust. If you are unsure about external network calls, do not enable automatic cron pushes and use the skill manually instead.
